name: @repo/db
description: The database layer on the Db port of @repo/platform: statement (plain data), query/queryFirst/execute/batch, all/first/run/allRows/firstRow, getDb; rows.ts (pure converters); migrations.ts and test-utils.ts (an in-memory D1 with the migrations applied, test-only). Query modules shared by several apps go in queries/<table_name>/ here, with an explicit exports entry each.
